note: All values are Pearson r computed from verified official data only; n = sample size. C7 is a mean, not r.

C1_net_vs_winpct_2025.desc: Pearson r between 2025 NET points and win percentage (32 teams, official standings)

C2_net_vs_winpct_2026_w8.desc: Pearson r between 2026 NET points and win percentage through Week 8 (32 teams, official standings)

C3_model_vs_actual_margin_2026.desc: Pearson r between walk-forward model margin and actual margin, 2026 W1-W8 (predictive skill of originated spread)

C4_samegame_margin_vs_total.desc: Pearson r between game margin and game total, same game (parlay leg correlation, gate G6)

C5_spreadbet_vs_totalbet_result.desc: Pearson r between spread-direction and total-direction results on the same game (same-game parlay leg correlation, gate G6)

C6_persistence_2025diff_vs_2026winpct.desc: Pearson r between 2025 point differential per game and 2026 win percentage (year-to-year persistence)

C7_home_field_2026.desc: Empirical home-field advantage 2026 W1-W8: mean home margin = 0.717 pts; home win rate = 62/120 = 0.5167 (assumption F09)
